d: Short platinum white hair with a single cowlick and side-swept bangs, paired with bright cyan eyes and a youthful, mature expression. A slender build and a young adolescent appearance. The outfit consists of a white sleeveless dress with a black underskirt, a large crimson ruffle at the chest, pink puffed sleeves, and a brown leather belt; the look is completed with crimson thigh-high stockings and white platform boots with silver spikes. Signature details include two curved red horns, a small gold crown, a long red demonic tail, and dark purple bat wings.
